description: Estimate the yearly cost of backing up ArcGIS Online content with Backup Manager (GBP, excluding VAT), using the same model as the calculator on the website. Describe one or more backup sets: number of hosted feature layers, records per layer, kind of content, attachments and their average size, daily or weekly, and copies kept; or give the size of one copy in GB if known. Returns storage per set, total storage, the pricing tier, annual cost and the history each set gives. With no sets, it uses the website's example.

backup_sets.description: Backup sets, e.g. operational data daily and reference data weekly.

attachment_mb.description: Average attachment size in MB (default 3; typical 0.5, 3, 8 or 20).

attachments.description: Photos or documents attached across the set.

content.description: Mostly points, survey points, simple polygons, lines, complex polygons or dense linework (default points).

content_gb.description: Size of one copy of the set in GB, if known; replaces layers, records and attachments.

frequency.description: How often the set is backed up (default daily).

layers.description: Hosted feature layers in this set.

records_per_layer.description: Typical records (features or rows) per layer.

locale.description: Website language: en-gb (English, UK), nl-nl (Dutch), be-nl (Flemish, Belgium) or fr-fr (French). Default en-gb.

name: estimate_arcgis_online_backup_cost
title: ArcGIS Online backup cost estimate
